τζάγγη , ἡ, a kind of
A.shoe, misi . . zancas de nostris Parthicas paria tria, Gallienus ap. Trebell. Claud. 17 ; usum tzangarum . . intra urbem . . nemini liceat usurpare,
Cod.Theod. 14.10.2 .
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
